builds.title: Dekanter Goblin gallery lookout, racial Hit Dice only
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 6 (2 racial HD, LA +4).
traits: Neutral. Dexterity +2, natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 14. BAB +2, grapple +7. Fortitude +4, Reflex +5, Will +5.
Cold resistance 5 and fast healing 3. Recover 3 HP per round from damage the ability can heal.
Power Attack can trade up to 2 points of melee attack bonus for the same damage bonus.
actions: Horn +7 melee, 1d6+5 piercing, critical ×3. Full attack with the horn and two secondary claws at +2 each for 1d4+2 each, critical ×2.
builds.tactics: Orrik watches the higher gallery. He prefers to stay by the narrow bend if a fight breaks out, where he has room to use his claws.

builds.title: Dekanter Goblin cold passage guard, Barbarian 1
builds.difficulty: Provisional CR 3. ECL 7 (2 racial HD, 1 class HD, LA +4).
builds.speed: 30 ft. with fast movement, base 20 ft.
traits: Neutral good. Studded leather +3, Dexterity +2, natural armor +4. Touch 12, flat-footed 17, armor check penalty −1. BAB +3, grapple +9. Fortitude +6, Reflex +5, Will +5.
Cold resistance 5 and fast healing 3. Recover 3 HP per round from damage the ability can heal.
Improved Initiative adds +4. Power Attack can trade up to 3 points of melee attack bonus for the same damage bonus. Fast movement and illiteracy.
actions: One-handed battleaxe +9 melee, 1d8+6 slashing, critical ×3. Add one secondary horn at +4 for 1d6+3, critical ×3, or one secondary claw at +4 for 1d4+3, critical ×2, on a full attack.

Rage 1/day for up to 9 rounds. AC 17, full HP 38, grapple +11. Fortitude +8, Reflex +5, Will +7. Battleaxe +11 for 1d8+8. The secondary horn or claw is +6, with 1d6+4 or 1d4+4 damage respectively. Lose the 6 rage HP and become fatigued for the rest of the encounter when rage ends.
builds.tactics: Tavra listens for the first returning crew before she opens the cold passage. She stays between the crew and the older branch of the mine.

concepts.name: Orrik Flintnose
concepts.motive: Find out why the lift has stopped before sending anyone down.
concepts.hook: Orrik signals from the high gallery that a rope is missing from the shaft.

concepts.name: Tavra Slatecall
concepts.motive: Keep the lower passage open for the returning crew.
concepts.hook: Tavra waits by the shutter and asks for news from the older branch.
